marc:datafield.marc:subfield: The Fixers is a secret underground organization that for the right price will solve any problems for their clients no matter if it is legal or not. The group is led by ex-con Szeto Sam-ping (Chin Ka-lok) who is an expert of escaping from authorities. Also included is certified lawyer and Sam-ping's lover Lui Lui (Mandy Wong), expert thief and fighter Wyman Chan Tai-man (Timmy Hung), talented hacker Mak Ping-on (Tracy Chu) and former government official Bak Suen (Henry Lo), who also handles all the accounting for the group
